testcase.name: server tag holds the bare lowercase domain with no scheme or port
authorization header uses scheme plus standard base64 with padding
x and size tags are omitted for operations that do not need them
token json round-trips back to the signed event
upload token is kind 24242 not NIP-98 27235
builds tags as json arrays of string primitives
one token can be scoped to the whole pool and never repeats a host
hash is lowercased so it matches the X-SHA-256 header and blob url
upload token carries the tags servers validate
